scientific_question: Does the qualified ROM1AR2 DISCOVERY library contain two accepted 16-node B01 physical profiles with equal total profile water but materially different vertical distribution when library-generation time is treated only as provenance and both profiles are later reseeded to one common canonical time?

eligibility.held_out_policy: HELD_OUT state and node observables remain excluded before parsing H/theta.
eligibility.provenance_note: FALLBACK=F applies only to the interval producing that state; antecedent trajectory may include qualified research fallback intervals.

observable_reconstruction.source: ROM1AR2_NODE H and THETA only plus state provenance/fallback metadata

frozen_h2_state_gate.physical_origin: unchanged conversion of RZM06A H2 gates after RZM06A6 unit audit

selection_rule.candidate_generation: all unordered eligible pairs from different histories, irrespective of original library time
selection_rule.qualifying_pair: both frozen H2 state gates pass
selection_rule.no_match: Close D03 NO_MATCH without relaxing thresholds or opening HELD_OUT/FALLBACK=T states.

persistence_if_selected: persist A/B split, history, step and original library T
persist reconstructed W_profile, M1 and upper-30cm water
persist all 16 H and theta values for both origins
persist pair deltas, candidate/qualifying counts and exact artifact authority
selected pair becomes immutable input to later common-time response qualification

common_time_rule.statement: Original library times are provenance only. No response comparison may occur until both selected physical profiles are independently reconstructed at the same new committed time.

next_if_selected: GC-RZM06D04 preregister and qualify exact common-time reconstruction of the selected pair, then only after reconstruction qualification define the identical fixed-Hc H2 response probe.
controls: D03 performs no E_c or terminal-flux probe
no response field may influence pair selection or ranking
nonclaims: D03 selection alone does not support or falsify H2
cross-time selection is valid only because D02R1 qualified common-time reseeding for this pure-hydraulics carrier
